title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents
author: Zedong Liu, Jiaan Wu, Xinyang Ma, Le Xu et al.

summary: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed. This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute relevant evidence.
takeaways: We present SparseRead, a reusable reading control layer that governs content admission without modifying the agent model.
Across six models, including Claude Opus 5, and five scenarios, SparseRead reduces total tokens by up to 92.9% and wall time by up to 89.0%, preserving or improving task quality in 97% settings.
This over-reading increases token and latency costs and can dilute relevant evidence.
